pageHeader.title: Event Console
pageHeader.description: Weather, time, sounds, player actions, and bridge tools

bridgeOfflineAlert.description: These controls need the Lua bridge. Connect it in <1>Settings</1>, then start the PZ server.

rain.label: Rain and storms
rain.hint: Start or clear rain and storms over the whole map.

timespeed.label: Time speed
timespeed.hint: Accelerate the in-game clock. Resets when the server restarts.

utilities.label: Power and water

quickSounds.label: Quick sounds

horde.label: Spawn horde
horde.hint: Spawn or clear zombies around a player in loaded cells.

bridgeOps.label: Bridge tools
bridgeOps.hint: Safehouses, factions, vehicles, and moderation operations.
bridgeOps.keywords: safehouse faction moderation kick ban operations advanced bridge

severe.helicopterTip: Draws nearby zombies toward the noise — not just ambience. Can bring a horde down on players near the flight path.

climate.rainTooltip: Starts rain using the precipitation slider intensity (minimum 5%)

timespeed.description: Accelerate the in-game clock. Useful for testing weather, day/night cycles, or fast-forwarding events. Resets to 1× when the server restarts.

utilities.b42Warning: b42 multiplayer · sandbox changes do not propagate to connected clients yet

quickSounds.hint: helicopter & gunshot pick a random online player · lightning & thunder strike the selected player (or random if “all online”) · alarm needs an admin in-game
quickSounds.lightningTooltip: Strikes the selected player, or a random one if “all online” is active
quickSounds.thunderTooltip: Thunders over the selected player, or a random one if “all online” is active
quickSounds.alarmTooltip: Requires admin character in-game — triggers at admin location

horde.removeAllConfirmDescription: This instantly removes every zombie in loaded cells, server-wide -- including any a player is currently fighting. Zombies respawn over time, but this ends that encounter right now for whoever was in it.
horde.clearNearConfirmDescTargeted: This instantly removes every zombie within the chosen radius of {{player}} -- including any they're currently fighting. Zombies respawn over time, but this ends that encounter right now for them.
horde.clearNearConfirmDescRandom: This instantly removes every zombie within the chosen radius of a random online player -- including any they're currently fighting. Zombies respawn over time, but this ends that encounter right now for them.

vehicles.sublabel: RCON · spawns next to a player
vehicles.spawnForTip: Only works if the player is on the ground floor or in a basement — fails if they're on an upper floor.

teleport.sublabel: RCON · move players in world space
teleport.zTip: The building floor, not a height — 0 is ground level, higher is an upper floor.

messages.lootNotice: Check your inventory for a surprise!
